dialogues.speaker: Everallin
dialogues.text: Hello there. The wind and the waves are both placid today. That makes for less stories, but at least people will sail in safety.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Stories?

dialogues.speaker: Everallin
dialogues.text: The harbor is not a place where waters and ships cross paths, but also one where stories gather.

dialogues.speaker: Everallin
dialogues.text: Many tourists, merchants, and even lovers of books from the land of deserts and rainforests come here.

dialogues.speaker: Everallin
dialogues.text: Many people love chatting with me, because that would be the first time they've ever met a Melusine.

dialogues.speaker: Everallin
dialogues.text: Thanks to everyone, I've also heard lots of stories from beyond these waters. It's great working here.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me about the sea.

dialogues.speaker: Everallin
dialogues.text: Observing the sea is my job, and I love it. While I'm around, you've nothing to fear from storms or showers — I'll warn everyone ahead of time.

dialogues.speaker: Everallin
dialogues.text: Oh, right, I didn't say so earlier, but I'm a Melusine — according to Monsieur Neuvillette, we have a deep connection to the ocean.

dialogues.speaker: Everallin
dialogues.text: And even amongst us, I'm one of the best at sensing the ocean's movements. That's why I've been assigned to work here.

dialogues.speaker: Everallin
dialogues.text: I just need to report on said movements and I don't have to wander out into deep seas, so it's a pretty comfy job.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It does seem like a nice gig.

dialogues.speaker: Everallin
dialogues.text: Yup, I think so too.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Adventure Challenge

dialogues.speaker: Everallin
dialogues.text: Though holding the cards isn't easy, this is really fun!

dialogues.speaker: Everallin
dialogues.text: It's so tough to hold the cards, and matches are so complicated. Ugh...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Deep sea...

dialogues.speaker: Everallin
dialogues.text: To be honest, I am not sure if my understanding of the sea's depth is the same as that which human beings sense.

dialogues.speaker: Everallin
dialogues.text: All I know is, diving is difficult for most human beings, and requires a heavy set of clothing and a lot of training.

dialogues.speaker: Everallin
dialogues.text: Do you know how to dive? It's okay if you don't. I brought these from the sea, and I want to share them with you.
